name: Gelida (Spain)
description: Divided horizontally into two equal stripes, yellow above and red below, with a blue curvilinear triangle at the hoist whose apex reaches the middle of the flag.
history: The flag was approved on 11 October 1993 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1812 of 22 October 1993; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided horizontally into two equal stripes, yellow above and red below, with a blue curvilinear triangle at the hoist with its apex at the middle of the flag.

features.role: curvilinear triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
